svg.title: Equipment lending station with plywood body, door, cover and divider
svg.desc: Three concept views of the equipment lending station made from eight 6 mm plywood panels. Body size 202 by 222 mm, depth 146 mm, excluding projecting fittings. Internal openings: equipment 139 by 210 mm, electronics 45 by 210 mm, separated by a 6 mm plywood divider. A: inset plywood door 135 by 206 mm with printed hinges and handle; plywood cover 41 by 206 mm with LED window and sound openings. Both panels have 2 mm gaps. B: Nano on a mini breadboard, DS3231 clock, servo and latch through a divider cutout, power connections and magnetic door contact. Equipment rests on the plywood base; inset panels leave about 134 mm depth before fittings. C: plywood rear panel with the five-volt inlet low behind the electronics. Hinge, latch and mounting details require CAD fit validation.
svg.metadata: -015 concept. Revised 2026-10-15: equipment lending station with plywood body, DS3231 with LIR2032, USB-C screw-terminal cable and magnetic door contact.
svg.text: Mirrored; power enters behind the electronics

g.text: 1 Plywood door; printed handle and hinges
2 Window with light pipe for the RGB LED
5 Door contact on the divider, magnet in the door
6 Nano on mini breadboard, USB-C down
8 USB-C cable to its screw terminal
9 DS3231 clock, LIR2032 to the front
10 MG90S servo; latch through the divider
11 Lever connectors: 5 V, GND, door contact
13 DC inlet in the back panel

svg.text: Printed: hinges, handle, mounts and latch
Body 202 × 222 × 146 mm; clear openings: equipment 139 × 210 mm, electronics 45 × 210 mm.
Door 135 × 206 mm; cover 41 × 206 mm. Both inset with a 2 mm gap; usable depth about 134 mm before fittings.
Concept layout. Printed hinge and latch fit, openings and component clearance are checked during CAD design.
